issues.problem: ZH says the parties' concession was '只是其中一步' (merely one step in the procedure); EN adds 'not the deciding one', a further claim about its weight that ZH does not state.
issues.suggestion: Drop 'not the deciding one' so EN ends '...was one step in it.'

issues.problem: ZH '要求先定下署名方式' asks for the manner of attribution/byline to be settled; EN narrows this to 'the order of the names settled first', while ZH reserves '署名顺序' (order of names) for the alternative in example.alternative.
issues.suggestion: Change EN to 'wants the way of signing settled first'.

overall: The English edition faithfully carries every fact, date, name, quotation and hedge of the Chinese edition, with only two negligible elaborations of nuance.
